reasoning_content: I need to check what columns are available in the instances table.

action.command:
docker exec sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -tAc "SELECT version_id FROM goose_db_version ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3;" 2>&1
echo "=== instances (first 8 cols) ==="
docker exec sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -tAc "SELECT string_agg(column_name, ', ' ORDER BY ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='iam' AND table_name='instances' LIMIT 1;" 2>&1
echo "=== instances rows ==="
docker exec sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -c "SELECT * FROM iam.instances;" 2>&1 | head -8
echo "=== graphile_worker schema ==="
docker exec sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='graphile_worker';" 2>&1
echo "=== app db roles ==="
docker exec sva-studio-postgres psql -U sva -d sva_studio -tAc "SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('sva_app','sva_job_worker');" 2>&1
